_doc: A turntable of real renders (cad/viewer/turntable.py <step> toolhead). views: frame_view.py --turntable; render: render.py options (owner's look 2026-11-17: AgX Punchy, plastic 0.2, -1.4 EV; the key light turns and tilts with each camera); page: the page's text (platform/viewer/turntable_page.py); publish: where the public page goes.

page.title: VT350 · Left head on the
page.foot: Real Blender Cycles renders (render.py, the render colour map, AgX Punchy, −1.4 EV), one every 10° round the toolhead at seven heights, from 40° below to 40° above. The light turns with the camera, so every side is lit the same. Drag sideways to turn it, up or down to change the height; arrow keys work too. Only these angles exist: for any angle, use the live 3D viewer.
page.credits: Parts: A4Tv2 and Orbiter (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, DW-Tas / Orbiter Projects), MadMax carriage, plate and clips (GPL-3.0, zruncho3d, andrewmcgr), Beacon RevH (MIT, Beacon3D), O2S and Smart Sensor (CC0-1.0, Lorincz Electronics); blowers modelled from measurements. Each part keeps its licence; non-commercial use only.

publish.blurb: 252 Blender Cycles renders of the left toolhead on the MadMax carriage: drag round it at 36 angles and seven heights, from 40° below to 40° above, with the light turning with the camera.
